verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since filers could plausibly export their filings and records, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any bulk export, download of account data, or open-format output. The items cover portal profiles, login tips, OHID security and tax tools, and the probes show only robots.txt walls, which says nothing about user data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
